spinner: A white star cut from paper with its red plate printed off register, snapping round a fifth of a turn at a time and holding each beat.
skeleton: Halftone strips with scissored edges; a red slash cuts across every line end to end, one after another, looping without a pause.
switch: A slanted cut-paper tab in a hard black frame; on, the track becomes the red plate and the white tab slams across.
check: A sheared cut-paper box on its red second plate; checked, it is pasted over with white and a red scissor-cut tick is slapped on too big, breaking out of the frame; the radio's mark is a red star on the same white.
toast: A calling card: condensed italic capitals in a black frame on a deep red second plate, slammed in sheared from the side; a success, info or warning card is printed on its own severity plate.
dialog: The calling card itself: tilted, hard red offset plate, the title in heavy condensed italic capitals over a red halftone backdrop, slamming in too big.
tooltip: A tilted white plate on a red one, black condensed italic capitals, popping out of nothing.
steps: A ransom note: each numeral cut from a different sheet and tilted, red slashes between them, the current one a larger red plate.
empty: A halftone void with scissored edges and the title in huge condensed italic capitals with its red plate off register.
link: A red underline at rest; under the pointer the word sits on the red plate in black ink.
